finding.query: Zustand store patterns for React state migration

research_notes.finding: Pattern: Replace local useState with Zustand store selectors and actions - Use `useStore()` hook for state access - Use store actions for state mutations - Ensure store is persisted to IndexedDB via dexie-storage
Migration strategy: 1. Identify all local state that should be global 2. Replace `useState` with `useStore` selectors 3. Replace `setXxx` calls with store actions 4. Test all component interactions

architecture_patterns.pattern: - Persisted State (IndexedDB): useIDEStore for open files, active file, panels, terminal tab, chat visibility - Ephemeral State (in-memory): useStatusBarStore, useFileSyncStatusStore, useNavigationStore - All UI state should flow through Zustand stores
- IDELayout.tsx duplicates IDE state with local useState - Recommended refactoring to use useIDEStore - State management cleanup is P0 priority

technical_notes.note: IDELayout.tsx is the main entry point for the IDE layout. Refactoring it to use useIDEStore will ensure state consistency.
The useIDEStore already has all necessary state and actions defined. No store modifications are likely needed - just connect IDELayout to the store.
After refactoring, test all IDE interactions: - Opening/closing files - Panel resizing/toggling - Chat visibility toggle - Terminal tab switching
